title: Fingerspelling alphabet
description: The 26 letters of the ASL manual alphabet. Palm faces out toward the viewer unless noted. Descriptions are for a right-handed signer; left-handed signers mirror them.

review.notes: Descriptions written from standard references; awaiting review by a Deaf signer.

items.handshape: Closed fist with the thumb resting straight up along the side of the index finger.
tips: Thumb stays beside the fist, not across the front (that is S).

items.handshape: Four fingers straight up and pressed together; thumb folded across the palm.
tips: Keep fingers together, not spread (spread is the number 4 with thumb out).

items.handshape: Fingers together and curved, thumb curved below them, forming the letter C.
tips: Viewed from the front the curve opens toward your non-dominant side.

items.handshape: Index finger points up; the middle, ring and pinky fingertips touch the thumb tip to form a circle.
Fingertips curl down toward the palm and rest on or just above the thumb, which lies across the palm.
tips: Fingers are bent at the knuckles, not a tight fist.

items.handshape: Index fingertip touches the thumb tip to make a circle; the other three fingers are straight up and spread.
Index finger and thumb extended and parallel, pointing sideways; other fingers closed.
tips: Hand is held sideways, like showing a small gap.

items.handshape: Index and middle fingers extended together pointing sideways; thumb holds the other fingers.
tips: H is G with two fingers instead of one.

items.handshape: Pinky straight up; other fingers in a fist with the thumb across them.
Start in the I handshape and trace a J in the air with the pinky.
items.movement: Pinky draws a J: down, then curves and hooks up toward your side.

items.handshape: Index finger up and middle finger angled forward in a V; thumb tip touches the middle of the middle finger.
Index finger straight up and thumb straight out, forming an L.
Thumb tucked under the index, middle and ring fingers, which fold over it.
tips: Three fingers over the thumb for M, two for N.

items.handshape: Thumb tucked under the index and middle fingers, which fold over it.
tips: Two fingers over the thumb for N, three for M.

items.handshape: All fingertips curve to touch the thumb tip, forming an O.
K handshape pointed downward: index points forward, middle finger points down, thumb touches the middle finger.
G handshape pointed downward: index finger and thumb both point down.
Index and middle fingers up and crossed, middle finger over the index.
Closed fist with the thumb wrapped across the front of the fingers.
tips: Thumb across the front for S, beside the fist for A.

items.handshape: Fist with the thumb tucked between the index and middle fingers.
tips: Only the thumb tip peeks out between the first two fingers.

items.handshape: Index and middle fingers straight up and together; thumb holds the other fingers.
Index and middle fingers straight up and spread apart; thumb holds the other fingers.
Index, middle and ring fingers up and spread; thumb holds the pinky.
tips: Thumb touches the pinky for W; the number 6 looks the same.

items.handshape: Index finger raised and bent into a hook; other fingers in a fist.
Thumb and pinky extended; other fingers closed.
Index finger extended; trace a Z in the air.
items.movement: Index finger draws a Z from the signer's point of view.
tips: Draw it as you would read it; from the front it looks reversed.
